deadline_expectations_title:
Late Policy
Late assignments will only be accepted without penalty for illness documented by a physician and by advanced permission of the instructor. All assignments are due by the deadline to make it fair to all of your classmates. Assignments handed in late will have 10% of the grade deducted per day late.
Guest Speakers
When a guest speaker is invited to class this semester, you are an ambassador for our college and ultimately represent yourself. Be prepared for their visit, complete any preassignments and write down three questions to ask the speaker in advance of their visit. You are expected to be interactive during their visit. They are taking time out of their workday to join us, make it worthwhile for them so they will want to return. Reflect on what you learned from the guest speaker after their presentation.
